headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录225篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究157篇, 开源项目38篇, 模型发布30篇。热门标签：Agent（54篇）。其中10%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ morluto /rea：Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

▸ mksglu /context-mode：Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists se

▸ cathrynlavery /diagram-design：Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 d

▸ vercel-labs /skills：The open agent skills tool - npx skills

▸ lyogavin /airllm：AirLLM 2.8T LLM inference with single 4GB GPU
